# Purpose

This companion report computes unit-weighted composite scores from existing
locked item-map and loading exports. It does not refit any EFA models.

```{r setup}
library(tidyverse)
library(psych)
library(knitr)

script_dir <- "17_composite_scoring"
csv_dir <- file.path(script_dir, "csv")
plot_dir <- file.path(script_dir, "plots")
dir.create(csv_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(plot_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

salient_loading_cutoff <- 0.40
cross_loading_cutoff <- 0.30
loading_gap_cutoff <- 0.15
min_clean_items_per_factor <- 3L

final_item_map_file <- file.path("03_efa_analysis", "EFA_Final_Item_Map.csv")
beliefs_loadings_file <- file.path(
  "16_exploratory_beliefs", "csv", "Beliefs_Exploratory_Loadings.csv"
)
existing_factor_scores_file <- file.path(
  "05_interesting_findings", "csv", "Factor_Scores_All_Instruments.csv"
)
existing_factor_lookup_file <- file.path(
  "05_interesting_findings", "csv", "Factor_Name_Map.csv"
)
beliefs_factor_scores_file <- file.path(
  "16_exploratory_beliefs", "csv", "Beliefs_Exploratory_Factor_Scores.csv"
)
beliefs_factor_lookup_file <- file.path(
  "16_exploratory_beliefs", "csv", "Beliefs_Exploratory_Factor_Lookup.csv"
)

cleaned_files <- tribble(
  ~instrument,        ~path,
  "IMI",             file.path("01_audit_cleaning", "cleaned", "IMI_cleaned.csv"),
  "WritingEfficacy", file.path("01_audit_cleaning", "cleaned", "WritingEfficacy_cleaned.csv"),
  "AIReflection",    file.path("01_audit_cleaning", "cleaned", "AI_Reflection_cleaned.csv")
)

assert_required_cols <- function(df, required_cols, context) {
  missing_cols <- setdiff(required_cols, names(df))
  if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
    stop(
      paste0(context, " is missing required columns: ", paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", ")),
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }
}

safe_alpha <- function(df) {
  item_df <- df |> mutate(across(everything(), as.numeric))
  keep_cols <- names(item_df)[map_lgl(item_df, ~ sd(.x, na.rm = TRUE) > 0)]

  if (length(keep_cols) < 2L) {
    return(tibble(raw_alpha = NA_real_, std_alpha = NA_real_, alpha_n_items = length(keep_cols)))
  }

  alpha_result <- suppressWarnings(psych::alpha(item_df[, keep_cols, drop = FALSE], warnings = FALSE))

  tibble(
    raw_alpha = unname(alpha_result$total$raw_alpha),
    std_alpha = unname(alpha_result$total$std.alpha),
    alpha_n_items = length(keep_cols)
  )
}

safe_spearman_pair <- function(df, x, y) {
  d <- df |>
    select(all_of(c(x, y))) |>
    mutate(across(everything(), as.numeric)) |>
    drop_na()

  if (nrow(d) < 5L || sd(d[[x]]) == 0 || sd(d[[y]]) == 0) {
    return(tibble(n = nrow(d), rho = NA_real_, p = NA_real_))
  }

  ct <- suppressWarnings(cor.test(d[[x]], d[[y]], method = "spearman", exact = FALSE))
  tibble(n = nrow(d), rho = unname(ct$estimate), p = ct$p.value)
}

row_mean_score <- function(df, item_cols) {
  rowMeans(df[, item_cols, drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)
}
```

# Inputs

```{r read-inputs}
final_item_map <- read_csv(final_item_map_file, show_col_types = FALSE)
assert_required_cols(
  final_item_map,
  c("instrument", "factor_id", "item_id", "item_text", "loading", "abs_loading"),
  final_item_map_file
)

existing_factor_lookup <- read_csv(existing_factor_lookup_file, show_col_types = FALSE)
existing_factor_scores <- read_csv(existing_factor_scores_file, show_col_types = FALSE)
beliefs_factor_lookup <- read_csv(beliefs_factor_lookup_file, show_col_types = FALSE)
beliefs_factor_scores <- read_csv(beliefs_factor_scores_file, show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  select(participant_id, Beliefs_UtilityComfort, Beliefs_FutureAIIntent, Beliefs_ConcernHarms)

factor_lookup <- bind_rows(
  existing_factor_lookup |>
    transmute(
      factor,
      instrument,
      factor_id = short_factor,
      factor_num = as.integer(factor_num),
      proposed_name,
      display_label
    ),
  beliefs_factor_lookup |>
    transmute(
      factor,
      instrument,
      factor_id = paste0("F", as.integer(factor_num)),
      factor_num = as.integer(factor_num),
      proposed_name,
      display_label
    )
) |>
  mutate(
    proposed_name = if_else(
      factor == "Beliefs_FutureAIIntent",
      "Future AI Orientation",
      proposed_name
    ),
    display_label = if_else(
      factor == "Beliefs_FutureAIIntent",
      "Beliefs F2 -> Future AI Orientation",
      display_label
    )
  )

cleaned_long <- cleaned_files |>
  mutate(data = map(path, ~ read_csv(.x, show_col_types = FALSE))) |>
  mutate(
    data = map2(data, instrument, function(df, instrument_name) {
      item_col <- case_when(
        "item_code" %in% names(df) ~ "item_code",
        "item_num" %in% names(df) ~ "item_num",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      )

      if (is.na(item_col)) {
        stop(paste0(instrument_name, " cleaned file has no item_code or item_num column."), call. = FALSE)
      }

      assert_required_cols(df, c("participant_id", item_col, "score"), instrument_name)

      normalized <- tibble(
          instrument = instrument_name,
          participant_id = df$participant_id,
          item_id = as.integer(df[[item_col]]),
          score = as.numeric(df$score)
        )

      normalized |>
        mutate(
          score = if_else(instrument == "WritingEfficacy", (score / 25) + 1, score)
        )
    })
  ) |>
  select(data) |>
  unnest(data)

beliefs_raw <- read_csv(
  file.path("02_efa_exports", "efa", "BeliefsAboutAI_EFA_Primary.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)
assert_required_cols(beliefs_raw, c("participant_id", "item_num", "score"), "Beliefs EFA primary file")

beliefs_long <- beliefs_raw |>
  transmute(
    instrument = "BeliefsAboutAI",
    participant_id,
    item_id = as.integer(item_num),
    score = as.numeric(score)
  )
```

# Item Assignments

```{r locked-assignments}
locked_membership <- final_item_map |>
  filter(instrument %in% c("IMI", "WritingEfficacy", "AIReflection")) |>
  transmute(
    instrument,
    factor_id,
    factor_num = as.integer(str_remove(factor_id, "^F")),
    item_id = as.integer(item_id),
    item_text,
    loading,
    abs_loading
  ) |>
  distinct() |>
  left_join(
    factor_lookup |> filter(instrument %in% c("IMI", "WritingEfficacy", "AIReflection")),
    by = c("instrument", "factor_id", "factor_num")
  ) |>
  mutate(source = "03_efa_analysis/EFA_Final_Item_Map.csv")

beliefs_loadings <- read_csv(beliefs_loadings_file, show_col_types = FALSE)
assert_required_cols(beliefs_loadings, c("item_id", "item_text", "MR1", "MR2", "MR3"), beliefs_loadings_file)

beliefs_clean_tests <- beliefs_loadings |>
  mutate(item_id = as.integer(item_id)) |>
  rowwise() |>
  mutate(
    loading_values = list(c(MR1 = MR1, MR2 = MR2, MR3 = MR3)),
    abs_values = list(abs(unlist(loading_values))),
    primary_factor_id = names(abs_values)[which.max(abs_values)],
    primary_loading = unlist(loading_values)[primary_factor_id],
    primary_abs_loading = max(abs_values),
    secondary_abs_loading = sort(abs_values, decreasing = TRUE)[2],
    loading_gap = primary_abs_loading - secondary_abs_loading,
    salient_loading = primary_abs_loading >= salient_loading_cutoff,
    cross_loading = secondary_abs_loading >= cross_loading_cutoff &
      loading_gap < loading_gap_cutoff,
    clean_item = salient_loading & !cross_loading
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  select(
    item_id,
    item_text,
    primary_factor_id,
    primary_loading,
    primary_abs_loading,
    secondary_abs_loading,
    loading_gap,
    salient_loading,
    cross_loading,
    clean_item
  )

beliefs_factor_counts <- beliefs_clean_tests |>
  filter(clean_item) |>
  count(primary_factor_id, name = "clean_item_count") |>
  right_join(tibble(primary_factor_id = paste0("MR", 1:3)), by = "primary_factor_id") |>
  mutate(
    clean_item_count = replace_na(clean_item_count, 0L),
    clean_factor = clean_item_count >= min_clean_items_per_factor
  )

beliefs_membership <- beliefs_clean_tests |>
  left_join(beliefs_factor_counts, by = "primary_factor_id") |>
  mutate(
    trust_composite = clean_item & clean_factor,
    factor_num = as.integer(str_remove(primary_factor_id, "^MR")),
    factor_id = paste0("F", factor_num),
    instrument = "BeliefsAboutAI"
  ) |>
  filter(trust_composite) |>
  transmute(
    instrument,
    factor_id,
    factor_num,
    item_id,
    item_text,
    loading = primary_loading,
    abs_loading = primary_abs_loading,
    source = "16_exploratory_beliefs/csv/Beliefs_Exploratory_Loadings.csv"
  ) |>
  left_join(
    factor_lookup |> filter(instrument == "BeliefsAboutAI"),
    by = c("instrument", "factor_id", "factor_num")
  )

beliefs_unassigned <- beliefs_clean_tests |>
  left_join(beliefs_factor_counts, by = "primary_factor_id") |>
  mutate(
    clean_item_count = replace_na(clean_item_count, 0L),
    clean_factor = replace_na(clean_factor, FALSE),
    unassigned_reason = case_when(
      !salient_loading ~ "primary_loading_below_salient_cutoff",
      cross_loading ~ "cross_loading",
      clean_item & !clean_factor ~ "factor_has_fewer_than_3_clean_items",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(unassigned_reason)) |>
  transmute(
    instrument = "BeliefsAboutAI",
    item_id,
    item_text,
    primary_factor_id,
    primary_loading,
    primary_abs_loading,
    secondary_abs_loading,
    loading_gap,
    salient_loading_cutoff,
    cross_loading_cutoff,
    loading_gap_cutoff,
    clean_item,
    clean_factor,
    clean_item_count,
    unassigned_reason
  )

composite_membership <- bind_rows(locked_membership, beliefs_membership) |>
  arrange(instrument, factor_num, item_id) |>
  mutate(
    factor = case_when(
      instrument == "IMI" ~ paste0("IMI_MR", factor_num),
      instrument == "WritingEfficacy" ~ paste0("WSE_MR", factor_num),
      instrument == "AIReflection" ~ paste0("AIRefl_MR", factor_num),
      instrument == "BeliefsAboutAI" ~ factor,
      TRUE ~ factor
    )
  ) |>
  relocate(factor, display_label, proposed_name, .after = factor_num)

write_csv(composite_membership, file.path(csv_dir, "Composite_Item_Membership.csv"))
write_csv(beliefs_unassigned, file.path(csv_dir, "Unassigned_Items.csv"))
```

# Composite Scores and Reliability

```{r score-composites}
score_long <- bind_rows(cleaned_long, beliefs_long)

composite_specs <- composite_membership |>
  group_by(instrument, factor, factor_id, factor_num, proposed_name, display_label) |>
  summarise(
    item_ids = list(sort(unique(item_id))),
    n_items = n_distinct(item_id),
    source = paste(unique(source), collapse = "; "),
    rowmeans_na_rm = TRUE,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

score_wide_by_instrument <- score_long |>
  semi_join(composite_membership, by = c("instrument", "item_id")) |>
  mutate(item_col = paste0("item_", item_id)) |>
  select(instrument, participant_id, item_col, score) |>
  distinct() |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = item_col, values_from = score)

alpha_table <- map_dfr(seq_len(nrow(composite_specs)), function(i) {
  spec <- composite_specs[i, ]
  item_cols <- paste0("item_", spec$item_ids[[1]])
  instrument_scores <- score_wide_by_instrument |>
    filter(instrument == spec$instrument) |>
    select(all_of(item_cols))

  safe_alpha(instrument_scores) |>
    mutate(
      instrument = spec$instrument,
      factor = spec$factor,
      factor_id = spec$factor_id,
      factor_num = spec$factor_num,
      proposed_name = spec$proposed_name,
      display_label = spec$display_label,
      n_items = spec$n_items,
      .before = 1
    )
})

participant_ids <- score_long |> distinct(participant_id)

composite_scores <- reduce(
  seq_len(nrow(composite_specs)),
  .init = participant_ids,
  .f = function(acc, i) {
    spec <- composite_specs[i, ]
    item_cols <- paste0("item_", spec$item_ids[[1]])
    factor_name <- spec$factor

    instrument_scores <- score_wide_by_instrument |>
      filter(instrument == spec$instrument) |>
      mutate("{factor_name}" := row_mean_score(pick(everything()), item_cols)) |>
      select(participant_id, all_of(factor_name))

    if (factor_name == "Beliefs_ConcernHarms") {
      instrument_scores[[factor_name]] <- 6 - instrument_scores[[factor_name]]
    }

    left_join(acc, instrument_scores, by = "participant_id")
  }
) |>
  arrange(participant_id)

composite_summary <- composite_scores |>
  pivot_longer(-participant_id, names_to = "factor", values_to = "composite_score") |>
  group_by(factor) |>
  summarise(
    n_nonmissing = sum(!is.na(composite_score)),
    mean = mean(composite_score, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd = sd(composite_score, na.rm = TRUE),
    median = median(composite_score, na.rm = TRUE),
    min = min(composite_score, na.rm = TRUE),
    max = max(composite_score, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  left_join(composite_specs |> select(factor, instrument, proposed_name, display_label), by = "factor") |>
  relocate(instrument, proposed_name, display_label, .after = factor)

write_csv(composite_specs, file.path(csv_dir, "Composite_Specs.csv"))
write_csv(composite_scores, file.path(csv_dir, "Composite_Scores_Wide.csv"))
write_csv(alpha_table, file.path(csv_dir, "Cronbach_Alpha_By_Factor.csv"))
write_csv(composite_summary, file.path(csv_dir, "Composite_Score_Summary.csv"))
```

# Validity Check Against Existing Factor Scores

```{r validity-check}
existing_scores_all <- existing_factor_scores |>
  left_join(beliefs_factor_scores, by = "participant_id")

validity_pairs <- composite_specs |>
  transmute(
    instrument,
    factor,
    proposed_name,
    display_label,
    composite_col = factor,
    existing_factor_score_col = factor
  )

validity_df <- composite_scores |>
  rename_with(~ paste0("composite__", .x), -participant_id) |>
  inner_join(existing_scores_all, by = "participant_id")

validity_check <- validity_pairs |>
  mutate(
    result = map2(
      paste0("composite__", composite_col),
      existing_factor_score_col,
      ~ safe_spearman_pair(validity_df, .x, .y)
    )
  ) |>
  unnest(result) |>
  mutate(
    abs_rho = abs(rho),
    p_bh = p.adjust(p, method = "BH")
  ) |>
  arrange(instrument, factor)

write_csv(validity_check, file.path(csv_dir, "Composite_vs_FactorScore_Spearman.csv"))
```

```{r validity-plot, fig.width=9.5, fig.height=5.5}
validity_plot <- validity_check |>
  mutate(
    plot_label = fct_reorder(display_label, rho),
    instrument = factor(instrument, levels = c("IMI", "WritingEfficacy", "AIReflection", "BeliefsAboutAI"))
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = rho, y = plot_label, fill = instrument)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.72) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.3, color = "grey35") +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-1, 1), breaks = seq(-1, 1, 0.25)) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "IMI" = "#4f79b7",
      "WritingEfficacy" = "#c96b3b",
      "AIReflection" = "#5a9367",
      "BeliefsAboutAI" = "#8c6bb1"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Composite Scores vs Existing tenBerge Factor Scores",
    x = "Spearman rho",
    y = NULL,
    fill = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )

ggsave(
  file.path(plot_dir, "Composite_vs_FactorScore_Spearman.png"),
  validity_plot,
  width = 9.5,
  height = 5.5,
  units = "in",
  dpi = 300,
  bg = "white"
)
ggsave(
  file.path(plot_dir, "Composite_vs_FactorScore_Spearman.pdf"),
  validity_plot,
  width = 9.5,
  height = 5.5,
  units = "in",
  bg = "white"
)

validity_plot
```

# Output Manifest

```{r manifest}
manifest <- tibble(
  output_type = c(
    "composite_scores",
    "composite_specs",
    "composite_item_membership",
    "unassigned_items",
    "cronbach_alpha",
    "composite_summary",
    "validity_check",
    "validity_plot_png",
    "validity_plot_pdf"
  ),
  path = c(
    file.path(csv_dir, "Composite_Scores_Wide.csv"),
    file.path(csv_dir, "Composite_Specs.csv"),
    file.path(csv_dir, "Composite_Item_Membership.csv"),
    file.path(csv_dir, "Unassigned_Items.csv"),
    file.path(csv_dir, "Cronbach_Alpha_By_Factor.csv"),
    file.path(csv_dir, "Composite_Score_Summary.csv"),
    file.path(csv_dir, "Composite_vs_FactorScore_Spearman.csv"),
    file.path(plot_dir, "Composite_vs_FactorScore_Spearman.png"),
    file.path(plot_dir, "Composite_vs_FactorScore_Spearman.pdf")
  ),
  description = c(
    "Wide unit-weighted composite scores by participant using clean locked items",
    "Composite definitions, item counts, display labels, and source exports",
    "Item-level membership for every computed composite",
    "BeliefsAboutAI items 6-22 that failed the clean-item or clean-factor rule",
    "Cronbach alpha for each composite's clean item set",
    "Descriptive summary of each computed composite score",
    "Spearman correlations between composites and matching existing tenBerge factor scores",
    "Bar plot of composite versus tenBerge Spearman correlations",
    "PDF version of the composite versus tenBerge correlation plot"
  )
)

write_csv(manifest, file.path(csv_dir, "Composite_Scoring_Manifest.csv"))
manifest |>
  kable(caption = "Composite scoring output manifest")
```
